alternatives.reason: Constitution II: provenance over assertion. The run's own claims (paths, checks) are recorded but the gate evaluates what was observed.
Constitution IV: deterministic gates may block but not approve; the candidate needs a named human, separate from the requirement and release decisions.
The gate rules are contract logic and can be verified against fixtures now; the GitHub adapter is an interface behind them and is exercised once the demo repository exists.

architecture_impact: Adds Candidate to the change ledger: an AgentRunRecord (agent-run-record/v1: agent identity, work order id + hash, starter, declared paths/commands) plus an Observation (branch, base, commits, changed paths, checks, reviews, compensating controls) evaluated by deterministic gates.

Gates: work_order_bound (id + hash), decision_current (staleness), branch_matches, commit_observed, allowed_paths (UI-10, violating paths named), forbidden_actions (modify:<prefix>), required_checks (PASS evidence per check; smoke/receipt/release-approval deferred to promotion), independent_review (UI-11; human ≠ run starter, or WAIVED under single-operator controls + AI review only when the target policy lists single-operator-controls), work_order_expiry.

Verdict order BLOCKED > NEEDS_EVIDENCE > NEEDS_REVIEW > CANDIDATE_ACCEPTABLE; only CANDIDATE_ACCEPTABLE can be human-accepted, the run starter cannot self-accept without a waiver, and a stale decision blocks acceptance and marks evaluated candidates STALE.

ReadBack interface with a GitHub REST adapter (compare, pulls, reviews, check-runs) enabled by GITHUB_TOKEN; provider observations override the declaration for identity/diff/checks/reviews while declared local checks and controls are kept. UNVERIFIED against real GitHub.
HTTP: POST /changes/{id}/candidates (optional read_back block), POST /candidates/{cid}/decision. React: candidate submission form, gate table, violations, second human decision.
cost_assumptions: No cloud resources; GitHub API calls only when GITHUB_TOKEN is set.
unknowns: GitHubReadBack UNVERIFIED: no demo repository on GitHub yet and the verification workspace's GitHub access is bound to configured repositories.
No real coding-agent run has been recorded; all candidates in evidence are declared fixtures (the negative and positive journeys).
An ACCEPTED_FOR_PROMOTION candidate whose decision later goes STALE keeps its status; the promotion gate (VS-006) must re-check staleness before deploying.
Forbidden actions are enforced by path prefix only; non-path actions (deploy:production, modify:iam without a path) are promotion-gate concerns.
acceptance_criteria: UI-10: a candidate touching a path outside allowed_paths is BLOCKED; the violating path, the evidence and the next step are visible; acceptance is refused.
UI-11: a candidate without an independent review is NEEDS_REVIEW and cannot be accepted; self-review by the run starter does not count.
A compliant candidate is CANDIDATE_ACCEPTABLE with smoke deferred to promotion, and a named human other than the run starter accepts it (change → CANDIDATE_ACCEPTED).
Single-operator policy: AI review + declared controls yields WAIVED and permits self-acceptance; without the policy it does not.
Work order hash mismatch, wrong branch, failed check and expired order each BLOCK; missing checks are NEEDS_EVIDENCE.
Provider read-back replaces the declaration and can block a candidate the operator declared as clean.
Consumer fixtures byte-identical after the browser journey.
